def peel_layers(grid, r0, r1, c0, c1):
    """Peel nested frames; each layer = same-color connected border ring of current bbox corner color."""
    import copy
    cells={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if grid[r][c]!=0}
    layers=[]
    while cells:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        top=min(rs); left=min(cs)
        # corner cell of bbox
        corner=None
        for c in range(left,max(cs)+1):
            if (top,c) in cells: corner=(top,c); break
        color=grid[corner[0]][corner[1]]
        # BFS same color from corner within cells
        from collections import deque
        comp=set(); dq=deque([corner])
        while dq:
            r,c=dq.popleft()
            if (r,c) in comp or (r,c) not in cells or grid[r][c]!=color: continue
            comp.add((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                dq.append((r+dr,c+dc))
        cells-=comp
        layers.append((color, comp))
    return layers

def stack(layers, r0, c0):
    """Restack reversed: layer i ring drawn from cumulative thickness; innermost fills solid."""
    import copy
    out=[[0]*30 for _ in range(30)]
    # compute bbox of union
    allc=[rc for _,comp in layers for rc in comp]
    R0=min(r for r,c in allc); R1=max(r for r,c in allc)
    C0=min(c for r,c in allc); C1=max(c for r,c in allc)
    H=R1-R0+1; W=C1-C0+1
    rev=layers[::-1]
    # thickness of each original layer: outer rect inset steps
    # reconstruct original rects: rect_k = bbox inset by cumulative thickness
    rects=[(R0,R1,C0,C1)]
    for color,comp in layers:
        rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
        rects.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    ths=[ (rects[k+1][0]-rects[k][0]) for k in range(len(layers))]  # assume square insets
    # output rects
    orects=[(R0,R1,C0,C1)]
    for t in ths[::-1]:
        a,b,cc,d=orects[-1]
        orects.append((a+t,b-t,cc+t,d-t))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    n=len(rev)
    for i,(color,_) in enumerate(rev):
        a,b,cc,d=orects[i]; a2,b2,c2,d2=orects[i+1]
        if i==n-1:
            for r in range(a,b+1):
                for c in range(cc,d+1): out[r-R0][c-C0]=color
        else:
            for r in range(a,b+1):
                for c in range(cc,d+1):
                    if r<a2 or r>b2 or c<c2 or c>d2: out[r-R0][c-C0]=color
    return out

def extract_objects(grid):
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in seen:
                from collections import deque
                dq=deque([(r,c)]); comp={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c))
                while dq:
                    rr,cc=dq.popleft()
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and grid[nr][nc]!=0 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr,nc)); comp.add((nr,nc)); dq.append((nr,nc))
                objs.append(comp)
    return objs

def solve(grid):
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    objs=extract_objects(grid)
    for comp in objs:
        rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
        layers=peel_layers(grid,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))

            for j,c in enumerate(range(min(cs),min(cs)+len(sub[0]))):
                if sub[i][j]!=0: out[r][c]=sub[i][j]
    return out
